conviction_note: Near-balanced: the 89% nine-month 進捗率 that makes the plan look easy is offset by Kojima's own POS bulletins (Q4 all-store sales -2.9% YoY, slightly below the plan's implied -2.1%), so FY operating profit probably lands within a few percent of the 8.2bn plan. The release adds a dividend decision under the new 40% payout rule (raised at the FY print in each of the last two years, a mild positive) and an FY27 guide set against the tough September comps the company has already published (AC -35%, PC -33%). That gives p_up 47 on an abs move of 3.0, scaled -0.18; findings sum -0.3. The two agree in sign and are small.

findings.finding: Kojima's own POS bulletins put Q4 (Jun-Aug 2026) all-store sales at 97.1% of last year (Jun 85.8, Jul 106.8, Aug 99.1) and the full year at 105.1%. The unchanged plan implies Q4 sales of 71,176m (-2.1% YoY) and Q4 OP of only ~800m (against 1,808m a year earlier). A margin bridge (Q4 GP ~27.5%, SG&A up ~2-3% on falling sales) puts Q4 OP at roughly 0.6-1.2bn, so FY OP lands near plan (+0-5%). The 89% progress rate does not translate into the large beat it seems to promise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY2025 print (2025-10-09 15:30) landed on the revised plan with no 差異 notice and the stock moved +0.65% next session. FY2024 print (2024-10-10) landed ~20% above plan with a 差異 notice and moved +4.08% (closes from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/7513.T).
findings.why_not_priced: The bulletins are public. What may not be priced is the arithmetic: the headline 進捗率 (89.4% ordinary on kabutan/kabuyoho, against 70.8% and 75.2% in the two prior years) reads as an obvious beat, and the stock rose ~17% from the Q3 print to its 2026-09-28 high. If the market had netted the Q4 sales decline against the progress rate, the stock would not have held near its highs into the print. It is already 5% off them, which suggests part of this is priced. Rule 1: the series is public, so this is kept small.
findings.independence: Parent Bic Camera's monthly (Bic+Kojima -7.5% in June against Bic -3.0%, +7.8% in July, +1.0% in August) implies the same Kojima pattern: https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s090943.html (2026-09-09). The Q3 supplementary shows the company cut its implied Q4 from ~2.0bn (April internal 9M forecast OP 6,162 against FY 8,200) to ~0.8bn while holding FY: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260709590391.pdf

findings.finding: The new 40% payout policy (from FY2026/8; DPS 28 set on plan EPS 68.41) ties the final year-end dividend to actual EPS. Kojima raised the year-end dividend at the FY print in 2020, 2021, 2022, 2024 and 2025 (by 2 yen in each of the last two). Any net profit above ~5.45bn (EPS >70) mechanically supports 29-30 yen, and the prior buyback (up to 900m) completed early on 2026-08-25, so a fresh one is possible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The FY2024 print with a 2-yen prior-year raise plus a 2-yen raise guided for the next year moved +4.08%. FY2025 (2-yen prior-year raise, next-year dividend held flat) moved +0.65%. The Q3 FY2026 print that introduced the 40% policy, +4 yen, an expanded 優待 and a buyback moved +2.74% (2026-07-14).
findings.why_not_priced: Whether NP clears ~5.45bn depends on Q4 extraordinary losses (the plan leaves only 112m of Q4 NP, so it budgets heavy Q4 impairments or tax), which nobody outside the company can see. The habit is visible (irbank lists the raises) but the size is not, so the price can hold at most the probability-weighted part.
findings.independence: Pattern of FY-print dividend raises: https://irbank.net/7513/ir and kabutan headlines 'コジマ、今期経常は2％増益、前期配当を2円増額' (https://s.kabutan.jp/stocks/7513/news/k202510090008/, 2025-10-09) and 'コジマ、前期経常が上振れ着地…前期配当を2円増額' (https://s.kabutan.jp/stocks/7513/news/k202410100008/, 2024-10-10). Buyback completion: https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20260825/140120260825525710/

findings.finding: The FY2027/8 guide lands against comps the company has already shown are hard. The first month of FY27 (Sep 2026) was 100.9% all-store, with air conditioners 64.7% and PCs 67.3% (Windows-10 and Tokyo-subsidy comps), and Q1 FY26 OP was 1,211m (+118% YoY). Kojima's initial guides were +0.3% (FY25) and +2.2% (FY26) ordinary. A flat or down FY27 guide feeds directly into a flat or lower FY27 dividend forecast under the 40% payout rule.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY2025 print: FY26 guided +2.2% ordinary with the dividend held flat at 22, and the stock moved +0.65%. FY2024 print: FY25 guided flat (+0.3%) but with a 2-yen dividend raise, and it moved +4.08%. The dividend line, not the profit guide, separated the two.
findings.why_not_priced: The September bulletin came out three days before the print, and the stock has fallen 3.1% since (1,464 on 10-06 to 1,418 at the seal), so part is priced. What the release adds is the guide number and the dividend forecast derived from it, which no one has: no analyst consensus exists (kabuyoho consensus blank). If the market had priced a flat-to-down dividend forecast, a retail/優待 register would already have sold the September record-date run-up, but the stock is still +11% above its pre-Q3 level.
findings.independence: The kabutan finance page shows the same conservative initial-guide history (FY25 guide 66.5 against 66.2 the year before; FY26 guide 79 against 77.3): https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7513. Same company, different document.

outside_window.finding: The '2027 air-conditioner problem' (new efficiency standards from April 2027) pulled AC demand forward in FY26 (Q3 AC +82.8%) and implies a demand cliff after March 2027, which would show in the FY27 H2 prints rather than this one.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none pre-filed; the FY likely lands near the 8.2bn OP plan (+0-5%), so a 差異 notice is unlikely. Returns: 40% payout makes a 1-2 yen final-dividend raise roughly a coin flip, and a new buyback is possible since the last one completed early. New-year guide: the main event, against hard Sep-Nov comps and a conservative habit; under the payout rule it sets the FY27 dividend forecast. Quarter: 9M ordinary 進捗率 89.4% against 75.2% and 70.8% in the prior two years, but Q4 POS sales were -2.9%, so the progress rate overstates the beat.
baseline_tension: Priced lean is +0.30 (margin overhang 0.37 favours shorts covering) and the run-up is mildly negative; my slight negative cuts mildly against the lean. The strongest positive the release could carry is a dividend raise above 28 or a fresh buyback. I looked for it: it is filed as the +0.4 finding and keeps the net near zero.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative on a public 月次/進捗率 series moves p_up toward 50): the Q4-sales finding went from -0.4 to -0.2, and p_up from 45 to 47.

Rule 1 (unless the release adds something): the FY27-guide finding went only from -0.6 to -0.5, because the guide and the dividend forecast derived from it are new information the release adds, although the September bulletin behind the read is public.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): checked. The strongest positive (a dividend raise or new buyback) was already searched and filed as +0.4, so nothing further moved; baseline_tension records it.
